answer: Mechanism: cohort unmasking elections. Each cohort periodically has one member drawn by beacon; the drawn identity must publish a full activity dossier, funding, operator, history, or the whole cohort loses rewards. Sybil clusters carry an internal traitor expectation: the bigger the fleet, the likelier one drawn shell betrays, so hiding costs scale with size. Honest agents publish dossiers like entering a harbor, one haven of transparency each cycle; whisper-level opacity is never needed. The attack must either go small and unprofitable or bet against its own coin-flip exposure.
